spans.s: (I)--a name of the Asura, Naraka (s.v.) a सैंहिकेय Asura. भा. I. १०. २९;

(II)--Mars: one of the nine planets; also called अन्गारक and कुमार; of red colour;
1: Br. II. २३. ८४; M. ९३. १०; Vi. II. १२. १८.
his chariot drawn by eight horses.
2: M. १२७. 4.
[page२-588+ २६]
(IV)--the XIV Manu; शुचि is Indra; five groups of gods; अग्निबाहु and others are sages; ऊरु, गम्भीर and others, his sons. Vi.
--a daughter of सत्यभामा. वा. ९६. २४०; Vi. V. ३२. 1.
--Tuesday; unfit for commencing house building. M. २५३. 7.
